data.name: Arcane Bond
data.description: At 1st level, wizards form a powerful bond with an object or a creature. This bond can take one of two forms: a familiar or a bonded object. A familiar is a magical pet that enhances the wizard's skills and senses and can aid him in magic, while a bonded object is an item a wizard can use to cast additional spells or to serve as a magical item. Once a wizard makes this choice, it is permanent and cannot be changed.|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Arcane Bond ~ Familiar,Arcane Bond ~ Bonded Object
